Query: name the unit of viscosity that is used in the international system of units.
Rationale: The Candidate contains a syntax error. In SQUALL, the verb phrase for 'has' (VP_HAVE) can be either 'RELATION NP' (e.g., 'has <measurement system> <International System of Units>') or 'NP2 REL?' (e.g., 'has the <measurement system>'). By combining 'the' (a determiner) with the relation, the candidate creates an NP2 ('the <measurement system>'), but then follows it with an NP ('<International System of Units>'). The grammar for VP_HAVE does not allow an NP to follow an NP2; it only allows an optional relation (REL?). To be correct, it should have been 'Which <unit> has <measurement system> <International System of Units> and <measure> <viscosity>?'
Representative Output: Which <unit> has the <measurement system> <International System of Units> and <measure> <viscosity> ?
